background: Bank of America Corporation is the holding company of the second-largest US bank, spanning consumer banking, wealth management under Merrill and a global corporate and investment bank.
synthesis: Ratings are A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A-, all three on a stable outlook, and nothing has moved since a one-notch upgrade by one of them on 3 May 2023. Both capital and liquidity sit on the weak side of US peers: CET1 of 11.2% is in the bottom quarter, and leverage of 5.5% and LCR of 112% are below their medians. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The newest flagged item, on 27 Sep 2026, is a research call on an unrelated issuer; the one that bears on the credit is older, on unrealised losses in the bond portfolio as yields rise.
